title: 购物车
problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个电商购物车。
它由一个**Cart**结构体表示，并通过数组**prices**保存商品价格。

输入商品的数量，然后是商品的价格。

请初始化一个购物车，并将价格添加到购物车的数组中。
然后，调用`Cart`的**show**()方法。
**show**()方法应该输出购物车中商品总价格。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Shopping Cart[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are building a Shopping Cart.
It is represented by a [b]Cart[/b] struct, which holds the item prices in an array called [b]prices[/b].

Your program needs to take the number of items as input, followed by the prices of the items.
Initialize a Cart of that size, and add the prices to the Cart's array.
After that, call the Cart's [b]show[/b]() method.
The [b]show[/b]() method should output the total cost of the cart.

The given code includes comments as instructions.
[note]Use a normal loop to take the inputs, and a [b]range[/b] loop to calculate the sum of all prices. 
Also, note that the prices are [b]floats[/b].[/note]
hint_md:
使用循环来获取输入，并使用**range**循环来计算所有价格总和。
另外，请注意，价格是**浮点数**。
